entries.definitionCN: 成就；业绩。对应 attainment 的「成就」义。

entries.definition: the successful completion of a task, or a skill so gained. It stresses the finishing rather than the reaching.
entries.definitionCN: 完成；成就；才艺。它强调「完成」而非「够到」。

entries.definition: the act of obtaining something, especially knowledge or property. It fits the 'obtaining' sense of attainment.
entries.definitionCN: 获得；取得，尤指知识或财产。对应 attainment 的「取得」义。

entries.definition: the achievement of a desire, promise, or potential. It adds a sense of completeness to attainment.
entries.definitionCN: 实现；满足。它在 attainment 之上加了「圆满」的意味。

entries.definition: to arrive at or attain, or the distance one can stretch. It is the everyday word behind attainment's formal noun.
entries.definitionCN: 到达；够到；可及的距离。它是 attainment 这个正式名词背后的日常词。

normalIntro.en: The family is about contact: attain, contact, tangible and contagion all descend from Latin tangere 'to touch'.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词族讲的是「接触」：attain、contact、tangible、contagion 都出自拉丁语 tangere「触碰」。

normal.en: at- 'to' + tain 'touch' + -ment: attainment is effort ending in contact.
normal.cn: at-「向」+ tain「触碰」+ -ment：attainment 就是努力以「碰上」收尾。

normal.en: Think of a target: an attainment target is the line a pupil must touch.
normal.cn: 想想靶子：attainment target 就是学生必须碰到的那条线。

normal.en: attain, contact and tangible all hide tangere, 'to touch'.
normal.cn: attain、contact、tangible 都藏着 tangere「触碰」。

normal.en: A person's attainments are the things already touched and kept — knowledge included.
normal.cn: 一个人的 attainments 是已经碰到并留下来的东西——包括知识。

normal.en: At the finish line the runner's hand touches the tape: that touch is the attainment.
normal.cn: 终点线上，跑者的手碰到绶带：那一下触碰就是 attainment。

abstract.en: The word always keeps a body in it: reaching is not wishing, it is extending until contact.
abstract.cn: 这个词里始终有一个身体：达到不是许愿，而是一直伸展到接触为止。

abstract.en: Act and result share one suffix: what you do and what you get are both -ment.
abstract.cn: 动作与结果共用一个后缀：你做的和你得的都是 -ment。

abstract.en: A school report measures a touch: how far a hand has stretched along a scale.
abstract.cn: 一份成绩单测量的是一次触碰：一只手沿刻度伸出了多远。

examples.en: The attainment of independence took decades of negotiation.
examples.cn: 独立的取得用了数十年的谈判。

examples.en: Her attainments in chemistry won her a place in the academy.
examples.cn: 她在化学上的造诣为她赢得了科学院的一席之地。

examples.en: The attainment gap between rich and poor pupils has widened.
examples.cn: 贫富学生之间的学业成绩差距扩大了。

dict_mnemonic.text: at（啊）+ tain（抬）+ ment（门）——啊，把东西抬到门楣上，终于够着了 → attainment 达到；成就

root: 源自拉丁语 attingere（ad-「向」+ tangere「触碰」）「触及、到达」，经古法语 ataindre 进入英语；核心是「努力伸长直到碰到目标」，再加 -ment 把这一动作及其结果名词化。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one gesture: reaching out until the fingers touch the goal. What is touched becomes an arrival, a right, an achievement, a body of learning, and finally a line on a school report.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个动作走：把手伸出去，直到指尖碰到目标。被碰到的可以是抵达、一项权利、一件成就、一身学问，最后变成成绩单上的一条线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the hand stretching out and finally touching the goal.
core.cn: 核心意象：手一直伸出去，终于触到目标。

branches.en: THE ACT OF REACHING: effort making contact with a goal, whether a place, a standard or an agreement.
branches.cn: 达到的动作：努力与目标接触，无论目标是地点、标准还是协议。

branches.en: ARRIVAL: the literal touch of a shore, a summit or a finish line.
branches.cn: 抵达：字面地碰到海岸、山顶或终点线。

branches.en: OBTAINING: a right or status entered, and any thing left behind by effort.
branches.cn: 取得：进入某种权利或身份，以及努力留下的任何东西。

branches.en: WHAT IS WON: a single achievement, and the accumulated learning a person carries.
branches.cn: 所获：一件成就，以及一个人身上积累的学问。

branches.en: MEASURED HEIGHT: a score on a school scale and the official target line.
branches.cn: 被测出的高度：学校刻度上的分数，以及官方设定的目标线。

intro.en: attainment is at- (ad-, 'to') + tain (tang-, 'touch') + -ment (act or result noun). The same tang- root, worn down to -tain or -tact, runs through contact, contagion, tangible and tactile.
intro.cn: attainment 是 at-（ad-「向」）+ tain（tang-「触碰」）+ -ment（行为或结果名词）。同一个 tang- 词根磨成 -tain 或 -tact 后，贯穿 contact、contagion、tangible、tactile。

latinIntro.en: Latin tangere 'to touch' yields attingere 'reach', contingere 'touch together' (whence contact), and tangibilis 'touchable'; its past participle tactus gives tactile.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tangere「触碰」给出 attingere「达到」、contingere「共同触及」（即 contact 的来源）和 tangibilis「可触的」；其过去分词 tactus 给出 tactile。

items.structure: at- (ad-, to) + tain (tang-, touch) + -ment (noun of act/result)
items.meaning: the act of reaching; an achievement or measured level
items.example: The attainment of a degree opened the door to research.
items.exampleCN: 取得学位为研究工作打开了大门。

items.meaning: to reach or achieve something by effort
items.example: Few runners attain that pace without years of training.
items.exampleCN: 没有多年训练，很少有跑者能达到那种配速。

items.meaning: capable of being reached
items.example: Set an attainable goal for the first month.
items.exampleCN: 为第一个月设定一个可实现的目标。

items.meaning: not capable of being reached
items.meaningCN: 无法达到的；高不可攀的
items.example: Perfect fairness is an unattainable ideal.
items.exampleCN: 完全公平是一种无法达到的理想。

items.meaning: the quality of being reachable
items.example: The report questions the attainability of the targets.
items.exampleCN: 报告质疑这些目标的可实现性。

items.meaning: the state of touching or communicating
items.example: The two plates meet at a point of contact.
items.exampleCN: 两块板在一个接触点相接。

items.meaning: the spreading of disease by contact
items.example: Doctors once blamed contagion on bad air.
items.exampleCN: 医生们曾把接触传染归咎于污浊的空气。

items.meaning: able to be passed on by contact
items.example: Her laughter was contagious.
items.exampleCN: 她的笑声很有感染力。

items.meaning: able to be touched, hence real and concrete
items.example: The project produced tangible results.
items.exampleCN: 这个项目产生了实实在在的成果。

items.meaning: not able to be touched; abstract
items.example: Goodwill is an intangible asset.
items.exampleCN: 商誉是一种无形资产。

latinEntries.meaning: to touch; to handle; to reach
to touch; to arrive at; to attain

definition_zh: 真实性；可靠性；真品性；正宗性；本真；真诚；权威性（古义）；原真性；认证有效性
definition_en: the quality of being true, trustworthy, or genuinely from the source claimed, whether in a statement, an object, a place, or a person
core_image: 一枚旧印章压在纸上：纸会旧、字会淡，但印痕仍证明它出自该出的人之手
scene: A curator under a lamp says: People ask about authenticity, but what they really want is a reason to believe the story.
sceneCN: 这里 authenticity 指「真实性、真品性」（第 1、3 个义项：内容与事实相符、物件非伪造）；句意：人们问的是真伪，其实想要的是一个相信这个故事的理由。画面里有放大镜、旧画框和一枚印章。

pos.zh: 真实性；可靠性；真品性；正宗性；本真

senses.title: True to the facts
senses.titleCN: 真实性：与事实对得上
senses.definition: the quality of being true to the facts, not invented or false
senses.definitionCN: 与事实相符、并非编造或虚假的性质
senses.example: Historians questioned the authenticity of the diary's later pages.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家质疑这本日记后几页的真实性。
senses.why: -ity makes an abstract noun of authentic, whose Greek source authentikos came from authentes 'one who acts on his own authority'. Truth here is imagined as a warrant held by the person who was actually there.
senses.whyCN: -ity 把 authentic 变成抽象名词；其希腊语来源 authentikos 出自 authentes「凭自己权威行事的人」。这里的「真」被想象成当事人手里握着的一份凭证。

senses.title: Worthy of belief
senses.titleCN: 可靠性：值得相信
senses.definition: the quality of deserving belief or trust
senses.definitionCN: 值得相信或信赖的性质
senses.example: The witness's authenticity was never in doubt.
senses.exampleCN: 这名证人的可靠性从未受到怀疑。
senses.why: Authentic meant 'authoritative, duly authorized' in mid-14th-century English before it meant 'factual'. The credibility sense still carries that residue: a claim is believed because its source is entitled to speak.
senses.whyCN: 14 世纪中叶的英语里，authentic 先指「有权威、经正式授权的」，后来才指「符合事实」。可信义仍带着这层残余：一个说法被相信，是因为它的来源有权说话。

senses.title: The original object
senses.titleCN: 真品性：不是复制品
senses.definition: the quality of being the original object, not a copy or forgery
senses.definitionCN: 是原件而非复制品或伪造品的性质
senses.example: Experts spent months confirming the authenticity of the painting.
senses.exampleCN: 专家花了几个月确认这幅画的真伪。
senses.why: Medieval Latin authenticus named a document with legal force; a sealed original proved itself. Applied to objects, the word asks whether this is the very thing, not a stand-in.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 authenticus 指具有法律效力的文件；盖了印的原件能自证。用到物品上，这个词问的是「是不是就是这一件」，而不是替身。

senses.title: Faithful to a place
senses.titleCN: 正宗性：照着当地原样做
senses.definition: the quality of following the original regional method or recipe
senses.definitionCN: 遵循原产地做法或配方的性质
senses.example: The restaurant's authenticity rests on its wood-fired oven and local flour.
senses.exampleCN: 这家餐厅的正宗性靠的是柴火烤炉和本地面粉。
senses.why: When a practice travels, 'original' becomes 'local and unchanged'. The noun then praises fidelity to a place's own way rather than to a document.
senses.whyCN: 一种做法流传出去后，「原初」就变成「当地且未改」。这个词于是称赞对某地自身做法的忠实，而不是对一份文件的忠实。

senses.title: The authentic self
senses.titleCN: 本真：做自己的那个人
senses.definition: the quality of living or acting in accordance with one's own character and values
senses.definitionCN: 按自己的性格与价值生活或行动的性质
senses.example: Her essays are valued for their emotional authenticity.
senses.exampleCN: 她的随笔因情感本真而受重视。
senses.why: Existential writers took 'acting on one's own authority' literally: an authentic person is one whose acts are their own, not borrowed. Authenticity becomes self-authorship.
senses.whyCN: 存在主义作家把「凭自己权威行事」按字面理解：本真的人，其行为出于自己，而非借来。authenticity 于是成了「自己写自己」。

senses.title: Unforced feeling
senses.titleCN: 真诚：不演出来的情绪
senses.definition: the quality of expressing feelings without pretence
senses.definitionCN: 不带伪装地表达情感的性质
senses.example: There was an authenticity in his apology that no polished speech could match.
senses.exampleCN: 他的道歉里有一种真诚，是任何漂亮辞令都比不上的。
senses.why: The social sense narrows the existential one: if the feeling comes from the self, it shows. Genuine and authentic overlap here, though genuine stresses origin and authentic stresses warrant.
senses.whyCN: 社交义把存在主义义收窄：若情感出自本人，就会显出来。这里 genuine 与 authentic 重叠，但 genuine 强调来源，authentic 强调凭证。

senses.title: Authoritative, in older use
senses.titleCN: 权威性：古义里的「正式有效」
senses.definition: the quality of being authoritative or formally valid, an older sense now rare
senses.definitionCN: 具有权威或正式效力的性质，此为现已罕见的旧义
senses.example: In medieval law, the authenticity of a charter lay in its seal, not in its story.
senses.exampleCN: 在中世纪法律里，一份特许状的有效性在于它的印章，而不在于它的叙述。
senses.why: The earliest English sense of authentic was 'authoritative, duly authorized', and the noun inherited it before 'factual' took over. The phrase 'of doubtful authenticity' still echoes that legal use.
senses.whyCN: authentic 最早的英语义是「有权威、经正式授权」，名词先继承了它，「符合事实」后来才占上风。短语 of doubtful authenticity 仍回响着那个法律用法。

senses.title: Fidelity to an original state
senses.titleCN: 原真性：复原到从前的样子
senses.definition: fidelity to an original state or style, as demanded in restoration or early music
senses.definitionCN: 忠于原状或原风格，如文物修复或早期音乐所要求的
senses.example: Early-music groups argue about authenticity in tempo and tuning.
senses.exampleCN: 早期音乐团体为速度和调音上的原真性争论不休。
senses.why: Restorers and period performers turned the question 'is it the original?' into a rule: reconstruct the object or performance as it once was. The noun names a standard of fidelity, not a physical fact.
senses.whyCN: 修复者和古乐演奏者把「这是不是原件」变成一条规则：把物件或演出复原成它曾经的样子。这个名词命名的是一种忠实标准，而非一件实物事实。

senses.title: Legally verified validity
senses.titleCN: 认证有效性：验过之后才算数
senses.definition: the legal validity of a signature, document, or record after it has been checked
senses.definitionCN: 签名、文件或记录经查验后具有的法律效力
senses.example: The notary checked the authenticity of the signature before the transfer.
senses.exampleCN: 公证人在过户前核查了签名的真实性。
senses.why: Forensic and legal usage keeps the oldest institutional sense: an instrument is authentic when it has been properly executed and can be proved so. Verification is the modern ritual of authorizing.
senses.whyCN: 法律与鉴定用法保留了最古老的制度义：文书经正式签署并能被证明，才算 authentic。查验就是现代版的「授权」仪式。

intro.en: Authenticity is a late abstract noun built on authentic, a word that began as a claim about authority, not about facts. Greek authentes was 'one who acts on his own authority'; -ity turned that warrant into a quality that can be questioned.
intro.cn: authenticity 是较晚出现的抽象名词，建立在 authentic 之上；而 authentic 最初讲的不是事实，而是权威。希腊语 authentes 指「凭自己权威行事的人」，-ity 把这份凭证变成一种可以被质疑的性质。

items.en: authentikos 'original, genuine, principal' came from authentes 'one acting on one's own authority', analysable as autos 'self' + hentes 'doer, being'. The deeper root of hentes, PIE *sene- (2) 'to accomplish', is reconstructed and marked source uncertain.
items.cn: authentikos「原初的、真正的、主要的」出自 authentes「凭自己权威行事的人」，可分析为 autos「自己」+ hentes「行事者、存在者」。hentes 更深的词根 PIE *sene- (2)「完成」是重构形式，标为「来源不确定」。

items.en: authenticus was the Latin form of the Greek adjective, used of documents and authorities. Legal force, not philosophical truth, was its first job in Western use.
items.cn: authenticus 是这个希腊形容词的拉丁形式，用于文件和权威。它在西方用法里的第一份工作是法律效力，而不是哲学真理。

items.en: autentique 'authentic; canonical' passed the word into English with its air of official approval and its missing -h-, which English later restored.
items.cn: 古法语 autentique「真正的；正典的」把这个词带进英语，带着官方认可的气息，也带着丢掉的 h；英语后来把这个 h 补了回去。

items.en: autentik is recorded as 'authoritative, duly authorized', and in the same period as 'real, entitled to acceptance as factual'. The two senses coexisted from the start.
items.cn: autentik 被记录为「有权威的、经正式授权的」，同一时期也指「真实的、可被接受为事实的」。两个义项从一开始就并存。

items.en: Earlier abstract nouns authentity (1650s) and authenticness (1620s) failed to settle. authenticity is recorded in 1760, formed from authentic + -ity, and that pattern won.
items.cn: 更早的抽象名词 authentity（17 世纪 50 年代）和 authenticness（17 世纪 20 年代）都没能站住。authenticity 记录于 1760 年，由 authentic + -ity 构成，这个模式最终胜出。

items.en: 'Genuine original' extended to art and objects, then to regional food and heritage, and in the 20th century to the self and to historically informed performance.
items.cn: 「真品原件」义扩展到艺术与物品，再扩展到地方饮食与文化遗产；20 世纪又扩展到「真实的自我」和「历史复原演奏」。

note.en: The first group shares the authent- stem or the -icity ending; the second group names qualities that answer the same question: can this be trusted as what it claims to be?
note.cn: 第一组共享 authent- 词干或 -icity 词尾；第二组是回答同一个问题的近义词：这东西能不能被信作它所声称的样子？

entries.definition: real, genuine, or reliable. Remove -ity and you have the adjective from which authenticity is formed.
entries.definitionCN: 真正的；地道的；可靠的。去掉 -ity 就是构成 authenticity 的形容词。

entries.definition: the process of proving something is genuine, especially a user's identity. It is an action noun, while authenticity is a quality noun.
entries.definitionCN: 认证；身份验证。它是动作名词，而 authenticity 是性质名词。

entries.definition: the quality of being false, imitative, or performed rather than genuine.
entries.definitionCN: 不真实；虚假；造作。

entries.definition: the creator of a work, from Latin auctor. It resembles authentic in sound but comes from a different family.
entries.definitionCN: 作者；创作者，出自拉丁语 auctor。它听起来像 authentic，但词族不同。

entries.definition: the quality of being real and not adulterated or imitated. It stresses origin, while authenticity stresses warranted truth.
entries.definitionCN: 真正；纯正；非伪造。它强调来源，authenticity 强调有凭证的真。

entries.definition: the quality of being based on sound reasoning or proper legal form. It covers the legal end of authenticity.
entries.definitionCN: 有效性；正当性。它覆盖 authenticity 的法律一端。

entries.definition: the quality of consistently working or being trustworthy. It matches the 'worthy of belief' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 可靠性；可信赖。对应 authenticity 的「值得相信」义。

entries.definition: the quality of being convincing enough to be believed. It is about the audience's trust rather than the object's origin.
entries.definitionCN: 可信度；公信力。它讲的是受众的信任，而非物品的来源。

entries.definition: the quality of being the first of its kind, or of coming from the maker's own mind. It overlaps with authenticity in art.
entries.definitionCN: 原创性；独创性。在艺术语境与 authenticity 重叠。

normalIntro.en: The stem authent- carries 'one who acts on his own authority'; -ity is the suffix that turns any adjective of quality into a noun of quality.
normalIntro.cn: 词干 authent- 带着「凭自己权威行事者」的意思；-ity 则是把性质形容词变成性质名词的后缀。

normal.en: authentic + -ity: add the abstract-noun suffix and the adjective becomes the thing people argue about.
normal.cn: authentic + -ity：加上抽象名词后缀，形容词就变成了人们争论的那个「真不真」。

normal.en: Same ending as reality and validity: -ity words name a quality that can be measured or challenged.
normal.cn: 和 reality、validity 同样的词尾：-ity 名词命名的是一种可被衡量、可被质疑的性质。

normal.en: A signature checked by a notary is authenticity in its oldest clothes: a seal that authorizes.
normal.cn: 公证人核对的签名，是 authenticity 最古老的样子：一枚授权的印章。

normal.en: authentic food, authentic self, authentic document: one word, three questions about origin.
normal.cn: 地道的食物、真实的自我、真迹文件：同一个词，问了三个关于来源的问题。

normal.en: The -th- in the middle is the Greek theta's footprint; the French form dropped it and English put it back.
normal.cn: 中间的 -th- 是希腊字母 theta 留下的脚印；法语形式丢了它，英语又补了回来。

abstract.en: Authenticity is not a fact but a claim: it asks who is entitled to say this is so.
abstract.cn: authenticity 不是事实，而是一项主张：它问的是谁有权说「就是这样」。

abstract.en: The same word covers a sealed charter, a village recipe and a person's inner life: authority has moved inward.
abstract.cn: 同一个词覆盖盖印的特许状、乡村食谱和一个人的内心：权威从外部移到了内部。

abstract.en: Every verification is a small ritual: the object does not change, only our warrant for believing it.
abstract.cn: 每一次验证都是一场小仪式：物件没有变，变的只是我们相信它的凭证。

examples.en: The lab uses isotope tests to establish the authenticity of the ivory.
examples.cn: 实验室用同位素检测来确定这批象牙的真伪。

examples.en: Tourists often mistake performance for authenticity.
examples.cn: 游客常把表演当成了真实。

examples.en: She writes with an authenticity that comes from refusing easy answers.
examples.cn: 她的写作有一种真诚，来自拒绝轻易的答案。

dict_mnemonic.text: authentic（真货）+ ity（一贴）——给真货贴上一张证明，贴上「真」的标签 → authenticity 真实性；真品性

root: 源自希腊语 authentikos「原初的、真正的」← authentes「凭自己权威行事者」（autos「自己」+ hentes「行事者」），经拉丁语 authenticus、古法语 autentique 进入英语；authenticity = authentic + -ity，把「有凭证的真」抽象成性质。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses circle one question: does this come from the source it claims? The answer may rest on facts, on a seal, on a recipe, on a period score, or on a person's own life.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项围着同一个问题转：它是否出自它所声称的来源？答案可能落在事实上、印章上、食谱上、古乐谱上，也可能落在一个人的自身生活上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seal that proves the thing came from the hand it names.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚印章，证明这东西出自它所署的那只手。

chain: A SOURCE THAT SPEAKS FOR ITSELF

branches.en: TRUTH AND TRUST: a statement that matches the facts, and a source that deserves belief.
branches.cn: 真与信：与事实相符的陈述，以及值得相信的来源。

branches.en: THE ORIGINAL AND THE PROVEN: the very object, not a copy, and the legal validation of a signature.
branches.cn: 原件与验证：就是那一件而非复制品，以及签名的法律确认。

branches.en: FIDELITY TO A PLACE OR A TIME: the local recipe, and the restored period performance.
branches.cn: 对地点或时代的忠实：地方食谱，以及复原的历史演出。

branches.en: THE INNER SOURCE: a self that acts on its own authority, and a feeling that does not perform.
branches.cn: 内在来源：凭自己权威行动的自我，以及不表演的情感。

branches.en: THE OLD WARRANT: authority and formal validity, before truth became the main question.
branches.cn: 古老的凭证：在「真」成为主要问题之前，权威与正式效力。

intro.en: authenticity is authent- (Greek authentes, 'one acting on his own authority') + -ic (adjective) + -ity (quality noun). The family runs authenticate, authentication, inauthentic and inauthenticity; author is a look-alike, not a relative.
intro.cn: authenticity 是 authent-（希腊语 authentes「凭自己权威行事者」）+ -ic（形容词）+ -ity（性质名词）。词族有 authenticate、authentication、inauthentic、inauthenticity；author 只是形近，并非同族。

latinIntro.en: Greek authentikos became Latin authenticus; the verb authenticare produced authentication. Latin -itas (stem -itat-) is the source of English -ity.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 authentikos 变成拉丁语 authenticus；动词 authenticare 产生 authentication。拉丁语 -itas（词干 -itat-）是英语 -ity 的来源。

items.meaning: the quality of being genuine or trustworthy
items.example: The authenticity of the manuscript was never seriously challenged.
items.exampleCN: 这份手稿的真实性从未受到严肃质疑。

items.meaning: real, genuine, or reliable
items.example: The shop sells authentic Basque linen.
items.exampleCN: 这家店出售正宗的巴斯克亚麻布。

items.meaning: in a genuine or original way
items.example: The room is authentically furnished for the period.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间按那个时代的原样布置。

items.meaning: to prove that something is genuine
items.example: Two experts authenticated the drawing.
items.exampleCN: 两位专家鉴定了这幅素描为真迹。

items.meaning: the act of proving genuineness or identity
items.example: Two-factor authentication protects the account.
items.exampleCN: 双重认证保护这个账户。

items.meaning: a person or device that verifies
items.example: The app serves as an authenticator.
items.exampleCN: 这个应用充当认证器。

items.meaning: not genuine; imitative
items.example: The accent sounded inauthentic to local ears.
items.exampleCN: 在本地人听来，那口音不地道。

items.meaning: the quality of being false or performed
items.example: Viewers sensed the inauthenticity of the speech.
items.exampleCN: 观众感觉到了那篇演讲的造作。

items.meaning: genuineness, in older use
items.example: The 1620s preferred authenticness to authenticity.
items.exampleCN: 17 世纪 20 年代的人更爱用 authenticness 而非 authenticity。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 真正的；原初的；有权威的

latinEntries.meaning: originator, creator; not the source of authentic
latinEntries.meaningCN: 创始者；作者（并非 authentic 的来源）

definition_zh: 真正的；真迹的；地道的；正宗的；可信的；真诚的；权威的（古义）；有法律效力的；原真的
definition_en: coming from the source it claims to come from, and therefore real, reliable, or faithful to an original
core_image: 一只手在旧画角落找到画家的签名——不是像，而是本人留下的那一笔
scene: A chef tells a visitor: This is an authentic recipe, copied by hand from my grandmother's notebook.
sceneCN: 这里 authentic 指「地道的、正宗的」（第 2 个义项：照着原产地做法）；句意：这是一份地道的食谱，是从我祖母的笔记本上亲手抄下来的。画面里有手写食谱、面粉和一口旧锅。

pos.zh: 真正的；真迹的；地道的；可信的；真诚的

senses.title: Real, not false
senses.titleCN: 真正的：不是假的
senses.definition: real and not false, invented, or imitated
senses.definitionCN: 真实而非虚假、编造或仿制的
senses.example: The museum bought the letter only after proving it authentic.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆在证明这封信为真迹之后才买下它。
senses.why: Greek authentikos meant 'original, principal', from authentes 'one who acts on his own authority'. A genuine thing is one that can stand as its own source, not a copy of another.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 authentikos 意为「原初的、主要的」，出自 authentes「凭自己权威行事者」。真正的东西能作为自身的来源站住，而不是另一个东西的复制。

senses.title: Of the original place
senses.titleCN: 地道的：照着原产地来
senses.definition: made or done in the original regional way
senses.definitionCN: 按原地区的做法制作或进行的
senses.example: She learned to cook authentic Sichuan food in Chengdu.
senses.exampleCN: 她在成都学会了做地道的川菜。
senses.why: Once the source is a place rather than a person, 'original' means 'as done there'. The adjective moves from legal proof to cultural fidelity.
senses.whyCN: 一旦来源从一个人变成一个地方，「原初」就变成「照着那里做」。这个形容词从法律证明滑向了文化忠实。

senses.title: Worthy of belief
senses.titleCN: 可信的：对得上发生的事
senses.definition: of an account or report, deserving to be believed
senses.definitionCN: （叙述或报道）值得相信的
senses.example: The book gives an authentic account of life in the trenches.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对战壕生活作了可信的记述。
senses.why: Mid-14th-century English also recorded 'real, entitled to acceptance as factual'. The word judges a statement's correspondence to what happened, so 'reliable' became its natural neighbour.
senses.whyCN: 14 世纪中叶的英语还记录了「真实的、可被接受为事实的」义。这个词判断陈述与已发生之事的对应关系，所以 reliable 成了它的天然邻居。

senses.title: From the maker's own hand
senses.titleCN: 真迹的：出自本人之手
senses.definition: being the original work, not a reproduction
senses.definitionCN: 是原作而非复制品的
senses.example: Only an authentic signature adds value to the print.
senses.exampleCN: 只有真迹签名才会给这幅版画增值。
senses.why: The legal document model — this is the very instrument, sealed by its maker — was transferred to art. The adjective then answers 'whose hand made this?'
senses.whyCN: 法律文书的模型——就是这一份，由制作者盖印——被移到艺术上。这个形容词于是回答「这是谁的手做的？」

senses.title: Sincere, not performed
senses.titleCN: 真诚的：不是演出来的
senses.definition: of a person or feeling, sincere and not performed for an audience
senses.definitionCN: （人或情感）真诚而不为观众表演的
senses.example: His surprise seemed authentic, not staged for the cameras.
senses.exampleCN: 他的惊讶看起来是真的，不是为镜头摆拍的。
senses.why: The existential sense of 'own' rather than 'copied' became a moral one: an authentic feeling belongs to the person who shows it. The word now praises the absence of pretence.
senses.whyCN: 「属于自己的」而非「抄来的」这一存在主义义变成道德义：真实的情感属于显露它的人。这个词如今称赞的是「没有伪装」。

senses.title: Authoritative, in older use
senses.titleCN: 权威的：古义里的「正式授权」
senses.definition: authoritative or duly authorized, an older sense now rare
senses.definitionCN: 有权威或经正式授权的，此为现已罕见的旧义
senses.example: The decree was authentic because the king's seal was on it.
senses.exampleCN: 这道敕令是正式有效的，因为上面有国王的印章。
senses.why: This was the word's first English sense, from Medieval Latin authenticus, translating Greek authentikos. Authority and authenticity were one idea before truth separated them.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最早的英语义，来自中世纪拉丁语 authenticus，是对希腊语 authentikos 的翻译。在「真」把两者分开之前，权威与真实原本是一个概念。

senses.title: Legally valid
senses.titleCN: 有法律效力的
senses.definition: executed in the proper legal form, so as to be valid
senses.definitionCN: 按正当法律形式作成因而有效的
senses.example: An authentic will must be signed before two witnesses.
senses.exampleCN: 一份有法律效力的遗嘱必须在两名见证人面前签署。
senses.why: Latin authenticus named documents that could be enforced. The adjective still appears in legal phrases where formal execution, not sincerity, is what counts.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 authenticus 指可被强制执行的文件。这个形容词仍出现在法律短语里，在那里算数的是正式作成，而不是真诚。

senses.title: Faithful to a period
senses.titleCN: 原真的：复原到原来的演法
senses.definition: reproducing the original style, instruments, or materials of a period
senses.definitionCN: 复现某一时期的原风格、原乐器或原材料的
senses.example: The ensemble performs authentic Baroque music on gut strings.
senses.exampleCN: 这个乐团用羊肠弦演奏原真的巴洛克音乐。
senses.why: The question 'is this the original?' becomes a programme: reconstruct period practice. 'Authentic performance' is a claim about method, not about a single surviving object.
senses.whyCN: 「这是不是原件」这个问题变成了一套方法：复原当时的做法。authentic performance 是对方法的宣称，而不是对某件幸存实物的宣称。

senses.title: Firmly evidenced
senses.titleCN: 确凿的：拿得出实据
senses.definition: of evidence, firmly established and not merely probable
senses.definitionCN: （证据）确凿成立、不只是可能的
senses.example: Police need authentic evidence, not a rumour from the street.
senses.exampleCN: 警方需要确凿的证据，而不是街头的传言。
senses.why: From 'entitled to acceptance as factual', the adjective hardens into an evidential standard. What is authentic has a source that can be produced and checked.
senses.whyCN: 从「可被接受为事实」出发，这个形容词硬化为一条证据标准。真实的东西有一个可以拿出来、可以核查的来源。

intro.en: Authentic arrived in English as a word about authority and only later settled into a word about truth. Its Greek ancestor names a person who acts on his own authority; a document, an object, or a feeling is authentic when it can claim that kind of source.
intro.cn: authentic 初到英语时讲的是权威，后来才落定为讲「真」的词。它的希腊祖先指「凭自己权威行事的人」；一份文件、一件物品或一种情感，只要能声称有那样的来源，就是 authentic。

items.en: authentikos 'original, genuine, principal' came from authentes 'one acting on one's own authority', autos 'self' + hentes 'doer, being'. The root behind hentes, PIE *sene- (2) 'to accomplish', is reconstructed, with no written record, so it is marked source uncertain.
items.cn: authentikos「原初的、真正的、主要的」出自 authentes「凭自己权威行事者」，即 autos「自己」+ hentes「行事者、存在者」。hentes 背后的词根 PIE *sene- (2)「完成」是重构形式，没有书面记录，标为「来源不确定」。

items.en: authenticus carried the Greek adjective into Latin, where it attached to documents, seals and authorities. The word certified a source before it described a fact.
items.cn: authenticus 把希腊形容词带进拉丁语，在那里附着于文件、印章与权威。这个词先证明来源，后来才描述事实。

items.en: autentique 'authentic; canonical' (Modern French authentique) entered English through Norman and central French, losing the Greek -h- on the way.
items.cn: autentique「真正的；正典的」（现代法语 authentique）经诺曼法语与中部法语进入英语，一路丢掉了希腊语的 h。

items.en: autentik is recorded as 'authoritative, duly authorized' and, in the same century, as 'real, entitled to acceptance as factual'. The -th- spelling was restored later by learned reference to Latin and Greek.
items.cn: autentik 被记录为「有权威的、经正式授权的」，同一世纪也指「真实的、可被接受为事实的」。后来学者参照拉丁语和希腊语，把 -th- 的拼写补了回来。

items.en: The factual sense won: authentic came to mean 'real, not fictitious', while genuine stressed that the reputed author is the real one. OED notes that the 18th-century distinction is not etymological.
items.cn: 「符合事实」义胜出：authentic 指「真实、非虚构」，而 genuine 强调所署作者确为其人。OED 指出，18 世纪的那套区分并不符合词源。

items.en: Authentic extended to regional food, heritage sites, the 'authentic self', and historically informed performance, so that fidelity to an origin became a value in its own right.
items.cn: authentic 扩展到地方饮食、文化遗产地、「真实的自我」和历史复原演奏，对来源的忠实本身成了一种价值。

note.en: The first group shares the authent- stem or the -entic sound; the second group names things that are real or believable, which authentic can mean in different contexts.
note.cn: 第一组共享 authent- 词干或 -entic 读音；第二组是「真」或「可信」的近义词，authentic 在不同语境下可以对应它们。

entries.definition: the quality of being genuine or trustworthy. It is authentic plus -ity, the abstract noun.
entries.definitionCN: 真实性；真品性。它是 authentic 加 -ity 构成的抽象名词。

entries.definition: in a genuine, original, or sincere way.
entries.definitionCN: 真实地；地道地；真诚地。

entries.definition: the process of proving that something or someone is genuine.
entries.definitionCN: 认证；鉴定；身份验证。

entries.definition: not genuine; imitated or performed.
entries.definitionCN: 不真实的；伪造的；造作的。

entries.definition: the creator of a work, from Latin auctor. The sound is close, the family is not.
entries.definitionCN: 作者；创作者，出自拉丁语 auctor。读音相近，词族不同。

entries.definition: real and exactly what it is said to be, especially of a person's feelings or an object's origin.
entries.definitionCN: 真正的；名副其实的，尤指情感或物品来源。

entries.definition: actually existing or happening, not imagined or pretended. It is the plain word behind authentic.
entries.definitionCN: 真实的；实际存在的。它是 authentic 背后那个朴素的词。

entries.definition: existing from the beginning, or being the first version rather than a copy.
entries.definitionCN: 最初的；原作的；非复制的。

entries.definition: convincing enough to be believed. It matches authentic in the 'reliable account' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 可信的；有说服力的。对应 authentic 的「可信记述」义。

entries.definition: allowed by law or by the rules, or reasonable and genuine. It covers authentic's legal and sincere edges.
entries.definitionCN: 合法的；正当的；合理的。它覆盖 authentic 的法律义与真诚义边缘。

normalIntro.en: authent- is the Greek stem for 'acting on one's own authority'; -ic makes it an adjective. The whole family turns on who has the right to speak for a thing.
normalIntro.cn: authent- 是希腊语「凭自己权威行事」的词干；-ic 使它成为形容词。整个词族都围绕「谁有权为某物作证」。

normal.en: authentic = author-like: both suggest someone standing behind the thing, though the two words are not related.
normal.cn: authentic 与 author 形似：都暗示有一个「人」站在东西背后，不过两词并不同源。

normal.en: An authentic signature is a signature you can put under a microscope.
normal.cn: authentic signature 是一枚可以放到显微镜下查验的签名。

normal.en: authentic food tastes of the place, not of the airport.
normal.cn: authentic 的食物有那个地方的味道，而不是机场的味道。

normal.en: Authentic and genuine are siblings in use: genuine asks whose hand, authentic asks what warrant.
normal.cn: authentic 与 genuine 是用法上的兄弟：genuine 问「谁的手」，authentic 问「什么凭证」。

normal.en: The -th- is a learned repair: French left it out, English put it back from the Latin.
normal.cn: 中间的 -th- 是一次学术修补：法语漏掉了它，英语照拉丁语补回。

abstract.en: The word begins as a seal and ends as a feeling: authority moved from the document to the person.
abstract.cn: 这个词从一枚印章开始，到一种情感结束：权威从文件移到了人身上。

abstract.en: Authentic always compares two things: the copy and the source it claims to come from.
abstract.cn: authentic 永远在比较两样东西：复制品，以及它声称来自的来源。

abstract.en: To call a thing authentic is to accept a chain of custody, even when the chain is only a recipe.
abstract.cn: 称某物 authentic，就是接受一条来源链，哪怕这条链只是一份食谱。

examples.en: The dealer could not prove that the vase was authentic.
examples.cn: 经销商无法证明这只花瓶是真品。

examples.en: We wanted an authentic meal, so we ate where the drivers eat.
examples.cn: 我们想吃一顿地道的饭，于是去了司机们吃饭的地方。

examples.en: Her anger was authentic and passed in a minute.
examples.cn: 她的愤怒是真的，一分钟就过去了。

dict_mnemonic.text: authentic 拆成 author（作者）+ tic——作者亲手交出的一笔，当然是「真迹的、真正的」

root: 源自希腊语 authentikos「原初的、真正的、主要的」← authentes「凭自己权威行事者」（autos「自己」+ hentes「行事者」），经拉丁语 authenticus 与古法语 autentique 进入英语；核心是「有一只手或一个来源为它作证」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses answer one question in different rooms: a letter, a kitchen, a courtroom, a gallery, a diary, a concert. In each, authentic asks whether the thing comes from the hand or place it claims.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项在不同房间里回答同一个问题：一封书信、一间厨房、一座法庭、一间画廊、一本日记、一场音乐会。每个场景里，authentic 都在问：这东西是否出自它声称的那只手或那个地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the maker's own hand, leaving a mark that a copy cannot leave.
core.cn: 核心意象：制作者本人的手，留下复制品留不下的痕迹。

branches.en: REAL AND VALID: a thing that is what it claims to be, and an instrument legally executed.
branches.cn: 真实与有效：名副其实的东西，以及依法作成的文书。

branches.en: TRUSTWORTHY: an account that fits the facts, and evidence firm enough to stand on.
branches.cn: 可信：与事实相符的叙述，以及足以站住的证据。

branches.en: ORIGINAL IN PLACE AND HAND: food cooked the local way, and a work from the maker's own hand.
branches.cn: 地方与手上的原初：按当地做法烹制的食物，以及出自本人之手的作品。

branches.en: THE SINCERE AND THE AUTHORIZED: a feeling that belongs to its bearer, and an old sense of official authority.
branches.cn: 真诚与授权：属于本人的情感，以及官方权威的旧义。

branches.en: FIDELITY TO A PERIOD: performance or restoration that follows the original practice.
branches.cn: 对时代的忠实：遵循原初做法的演出或修复。

intro.en: authentic is authent- (Greek authentes, 'one acting on his own authority') + -ic (adjective). Its family shows -ity, -ly, -ate, -ation, -or, and the negative prefix in-; author is a look-alike from Latin auctor, not a relative.
intro.cn: authentic 是 authent-（希腊语 authentes「凭自己权威行事者」）+ -ic（形容词）。词族展示 -ity、-ly、-ate、-ation、-or 以及否定前缀 in-；author 是出自拉丁语 auctor 的形近词，并非同族。

latinIntro.en: Greek authentikos gave Latin authenticus; authenticare 'to make valid' gave authenticate; -icus and -itat- are the suffixes behind English -ic and -ity.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 authentikos 给出拉丁语 authenticus；authenticare「使有效」给出 authenticate；-icus 与 -itat- 是英语 -ic 与 -ity 背后的后缀。

items.meaning: real, genuine, or reliable
items.example: The document is authentic, not a nineteenth-century copy.
items.exampleCN: 这份文件是真件，不是 19 世纪的复制品。

items.meaning: the quality of being genuine
items.example: The authenticity of the relic is disputed.
items.exampleCN: 这件圣物的真伪有争议。

items.meaning: in a genuine or original way
items.example: The dish is cooked authentically, with no shortcuts.
items.exampleCN: 这道菜做得地道，没有偷工减料。

items.meaning: to establish the genuineness of something
items.example: The signature was authenticated by a handwriting expert.
items.exampleCN: 签名经笔迹专家鉴定为真。

items.meaning: the act of proving genuineness
items.example: Authentication of the painting took six weeks.
items.exampleCN: 这幅画的鉴定用了六周。

items.meaning: one who or that which verifies
items.example: The token works as a second authenticator.
items.exampleCN: 这个令牌充当第二重认证器。

items.meaning: not genuine
items.example: The label warned buyers of inauthentic goods.
items.exampleCN: 标签提醒买家提防仿冒商品。

items.meaning: the quality of being false or staged
items.example: Critics noted the inauthenticity of the accent.
items.exampleCN: 评论者指出那口音不自然。

items.meaning: genuineness, in older English
items.example: The word authenticness was current in the 1620s.
items.exampleCN: authenticness 一词在 17 世纪 20 年代通用。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 真正的；原初的；有权威的

latinEntries.structure: auctor (noun; not the source of authentic)
latinEntries.meaningCN: 创始者；作者（并非 authentic 的来源）

definition_zh: 自动化；自动操作；自动化技术；工业自动化；办公自动化；自动化程度；自动装置；自动化流程；机械化的无意识
definition_en: the use of self-acting machines or programs to perform work, and the equipment, state, or degree produced by that use
core_image: 一只看不见的手在车间里按节拍运转：齿轮、传送带和程序自己动起来，人退到一旁看着
scene: A plant manager walks the line and says: Automation did not remove the workers; it moved them to the screens.
sceneCN: 这里 automation 指「自动化、自动操作」（第 1、2 个义项：用机器代替人工作、自动运行）；句意：自动化并没有让工人消失，只是把他们挪到了屏幕前。画面里有机械臂、控制台和一条传送带。

pos.zh: 自动化；自动操作；自动化技术；自动装置

derivatives.zh: 自动装置；机械般行动的人

senses.title: Machines doing the work
senses.titleCN: 自动化：让机器替人干活
senses.definition: the use of machines to perform work that people used to do
senses.definitionCN: 使用机器完成过去由人做的工作
senses.example: Automation has cut the time needed to assemble a car.
senses.exampleCN: 自动化缩短了组装一辆汽车所需的时间。
senses.why: The word was coined in 1948 by Ford's manufacturing vice-president Delmar S. Harder, from automatic + -ion, for 'the large-scale use of automatic equipment in production'. Greek automatos already meant 'moving by itself', so the noun is that image applied to a whole process.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由福特公司主管制造的副总裁德尔马·S·哈德于 1948 年用 automatic + -ion 造出，指「生产中大规模使用自动设备」。希腊语 automatos 本就意为「自己会动」，这个名词就是把那个意象套到整个流程上。

senses.title: Running without a hand
senses.titleCN: 自动操作：不用人手去推
senses.definition: the automatic operation or control of equipment or a process
senses.definitionCN: 设备或流程的自动运行或自动控制
senses.example: The pump runs on automation, with one operator per line.
senses.exampleCN: 这台泵靠自动操作运行，每条线只需一名操作员。
senses.why: -ion makes an action noun, and here the action belongs to the machine: control has passed from hand to mechanism. That transfer is the heart of Greek autos 'self'.
senses.whyCN: -ion 构成动作名词，而这里的动作属于机器：控制权从人手转到机构。这次移交正是希腊语 autos「自己」的核心。

senses.title: The technology itself
senses.titleCN: 自动化技术：让机器自己动的那套本事
senses.definition: the technology or set of systems that performs tasks without human control
senses.definitionCN: 无需人工控制即可执行任务的技术或系统
senses.example: Cheap sensors have brought automation to small farms.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价传感器把自动化技术带到了小农场。
senses.why: Industry turned the process noun into a mass noun for the hardware and software behind it. The word shifts from 'doing it by itself' to 'the means of doing it by itself'.
senses.whyCN: 工业界把这个过程名词变成指硬件与软件的不可数名词。词义从「它自己去做」滑到「让它自己去做的那套手段」。

senses.title: On the factory floor
senses.titleCN: 工业自动化：在车间里生根
senses.definition: automation applied to manufacturing and production lines
senses.definitionCN: 应用于制造业和生产线的自动化
senses.example: Industrial automation replaced most of the welding jobs.
senses.exampleCN: 工业自动化取代了大部分焊接岗位。
senses.why: Ford's coinage was a manufacturing word before it was a general one. The compound keeps the original setting: the factory where the term was born in 1948.
senses.whyCN: 福特造这个词时，它先是制造业用语，后来才一般化。这个复合词保留了最初的场景：1948 年诞生该词的那座工厂。

senses.title: At the desk
senses.titleCN: 办公自动化：从车间挪到办公桌
senses.definition: the use of computers and software to handle office paperwork
senses.definitionCN: 用计算机和软件处理办公室文书工作
senses.example: Office automation moved the files from cabinets to a shared drive.
senses.exampleCN: 办公自动化把文件从档案柜搬到了共享硬盘。
senses.why: In the 1950s and 1960s the same promise moved from the shop floor to the desk. The metaphor is identical: routine steps are handed to a machine that does not tire.
senses.whyCN: 20 世纪 50、60 年代，同一个承诺从车间移到办公桌。比喻完全一样：把例行步骤交给一台不会累的机器。

senses.title: How far it has gone
senses.titleCN: 自动化程度：看看交出去多少
senses.definition: the degree to which a process is performed by machines rather than people
senses.definitionCN: 某一流程由机器而非人完成的程度
senses.example: The report compares levels of automation across five ports.
senses.exampleCN: 报告比较了五个港口的自动化程度。
senses.why: A countable use developed from the process noun, as with 'a production'. It measures how far the self-acting has gone, not whether it exists at all.
senses.whyCN: 这个过程名词发展出可数用法，就像 a production。它衡量「自己动」走到了多远，而不是到底有没有。

senses.title: The equipment that does it
senses.titleCN: 自动装置：把「自动」装成一台东西
senses.definition: a machine or set of devices that operates automatically
senses.definitionCN: 自动运行的机器或设备组合
senses.example: The basement is full of old automation that still opens the gates.
senses.exampleCN: 地下室里装满了仍在开门的旧自动装置。
senses.why: Concrete for abstract: the noun of action came to mean the things that carry the action out. English often treats a process as an object once it is installed.
senses.whyCN: 抽象变具体：动作名词转而指执行该动作的那些东西。英语常把装好了的流程当成一件物品来说。

senses.title: A script that acts alone
senses.titleCN: 自动化流程：软件里的自动动作
senses.definition: a programmed sequence that runs a task without a user
senses.definitionCN: 无需用户操作即可执行任务的程序化序列
senses.example: We built an automation that files every invoice overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 我们做了一个自动化流程，每晚把发票归档。
senses.why: Software generalized the factory word to any repeated task. The 'machine' is now a script, but it still acts on its own, the original sense of automatos.
senses.whyCN: 软件把这个工厂词推广到任何重复任务。这里的「机器」成了脚本，但它仍在自己行动，正是 automatos 的原义。

senses.title: Acting like a machine
senses.titleCN: 机械化的无意识：人也会「自动运行」
senses.definition: the state of acting by routine, without thought or will
senses.definitionCN: 按惯例行动、没有思考或意志的状态
senses.example: Years of teaching had turned his lessons into mere automation.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的教学把他的课变成了纯粹的机械重复。
senses.why: If a machine acts by itself, a person can also act 'by itself' — that is, with no mind behind the action. The word keeps its Greek link to matos 'thinking': too little thinking is the failure.
senses.whyCN: 机器能「自己动」，人也能「自己动」——也就是行动背后没有心智。这个词保留着与希腊语 matos「思考」的联系：思考太少就是问题所在。

intro.en: Automation is a modern coinage with a Greek skeleton. Greek automatos 'self-moving' gave English automatic; in 1948 Ford's manufacturing vice-president Delmar S. Harder built automation from automatic plus the noun suffix -ion to name the large-scale use of self-acting equipment.
intro.cn: automation 是一个装着希腊骨架的现代新词。希腊语 automatos「自己会动」给出英语 automatic；1948 年福特公司主管制造的副总裁德尔马·S·哈德用 automatic 加名词后缀 -ion 造出 automation，指大规模使用自动设备。

items.en: automatos meant 'acting of one's own will' of persons and 'self-moving' of things, used of the gates of Olympus and the tripods of Hephaestus. It joins autos 'self' with -matos, from PIE *men- (1) 'to think', a reconstructed root.
items.cn: automatos 用于人时指“按自己意志行事”，用于物时指“自己会动”，曾描述奥林匹斯的大门和赫菲斯托斯的三脚鼎。它由 autos“自己”和 -matos（源自印欧语 *men-“思考”）构成，该词根是重构形式，标为“来源不确定”。

items.en: automatical is recorded in the 1580s and automatous in the 1640s, both meaning 'acting by itself'. These adjectives, not the noun, were the first English words in the family.
items.cn: automatical 记录于 16 世纪 80 年代，automatous 记录于 17 世纪 40 年代，二者都意为“自行动作的”。进入英语的先是形容词，而不是名词。

items.en: automaton enters as 'a self-moving thing', borrowed from the Greek neuter automaton. The word still names a machine that imitates life, or a person who moves like one.
items.cn: automaton 以“自己会动的东西”进入英语，借自希腊语中性形式 automaton。这个词至今指模仿生命的机器，或像机器一样行动的人。

items.en: automatic appears in 1812 for 'self-acting'; 1748 had already applied it to involuntary human actions, and by 1850 it named self-acting machinery. automatism (1838) named the quality of being automatic.
items.cn: automatic 于 1812 年出现，意为“自动的”；1748 年它已用于人的不自主动作，到 1850 年又指自动机械。automatism（1838）则指“自动的性质”。

items.en: automat (1903) named a self-service cafeteria, a place where the machinery, not a waiter, served the customer. The coinage shows the family moving from single devices toward whole systems.
items.cn: automat（1903）指自助餐厅——由机器而不是服务员接待顾客的场所。这个词显示这一词族正从单个装置走向整套系统。

items.en: automation was coined in 1948 by Ford executive Delmar S. Harder for 'the large-scale use of automatic equipment in production', from automatic + -ion. It spread to office work, computing and robotics, and took on the figurative sense of mindless routine.
items.cn: automation 由福特公司高管德尔马·S·哈德于 1948 年造出，指“生产中大规模使用自动设备”，由 automatic + -ion 构成。它随后扩展到办公、计算与机器人领域，并获得“像机器一样不假思索地例行运转”的比喻义。

note.en: The first group shares the automat- stem and the -tion/-ic endings; the second group names other ways of replacing human labour with machinery or code.
note.cn: 第一组共享 automat- 词干与 -tion/-ic 词尾；第二组是其他「用机器或代码替代人力」的说法。

entries.definition: self-acting; working by itself. It is the adjective from which automation was coined with -ion.
entries.definitionCN: 自动的；自行运转的。automation 就是由它加 -ion 造出。

entries.definition: by itself, without a person operating it; also without thinking.
entries.definitionCN: 自动地；不假思索地。

entries.definition: to convert a process to automatic operation. It is a back-formation felt as the verb of automation.
entries.definitionCN: 使自动化。它是被视为 automation 动词的回构词。

entries.definition: a machine that imitates a living being, or a person who acts mechanically.
entries.definitionCN: 自动装置；机械般行动的人。

entries.definition: automatic action, especially without conscious control.
entries.definitionCN: 自动作用；无意识行为。

entries.definition: the introduction of machinery to replace human or animal labour. It is the older, mechanical cousin of automation.
entries.definitionCN: 机械化；用机器替代人力或畜力。它是 automation 更早的机械表亲。

entries.definition: the technology of robots, a branch of automation concerned with machines that sense and act.
entries.definitionCN: 机器人技术；automation 中研究会感知、会行动的机器的那一支。

entries.definition: the process of replacing paper or manual work with computers.
entries.definitionCN: 计算机化；用计算机取代纸面或手工工作。

entries.definition: the act or process of making something automatic; a near synonym of automation.
entries.definitionCN: 自动化（过程）；automation 的近义词，较罕用。

entries.definition: the development of industry on a large scale, of which automation is one phase.
entries.definitionCN: 工业化；automation 是其中一个阶段。

normalIntro.en: auto- is 'self', -mat- is 'acting or thinking', and -tion makes a process noun: automation is the process of something acting by itself.
normalIntro.cn: auto- 是「自己」，-mat- 是「行动或思考」，-tion 把动作变成过程名词：automation 就是「某物自己行动」的过程。

normal.en: auto 'self' + mat 'acting' + -ion: the machine acts as its own operator.
normal.cn: auto「自己」+ mat「行动」+ -ion：机器成了自己的操作员。

normal.en: Ford's vice-president Delmar Harder needed one word for automatic equipment in production, and clipped automatic + -ion into automation in 1948.
normal.cn: 福特的副总裁德尔马·哈德需要一个词来说生产中的自动设备，1948 年把 automatic + -ion 截成了 automation。

normal.en: automatic, automaton, automatism: the whole family shares the image of a thing that moves without a hand.
normal.cn: automatic、automaton、automatism：整个词族共享「没有手推也会动」的意象。

normal.en: Office automation is the same factory promise, sitting at a desk with a screen.
normal.cn: 办公自动化是同一个工厂承诺，坐在办公桌前，对着一块屏幕。

normal.en: A script that files invoices overnight is a small automation, and still a machine acting alone.
normal.cn: 每晚归档发票的脚本就是一个小小的 automation，仍然是一台独自行动的机器。

abstract.en: The word names a transfer: not the tool but the handing over of control.
abstract.cn: 这个词命名的是一次移交：不是工具本身，而是控制权的交出。

abstract.en: Automation makes a process into a thing you can count, buy, install and measure.
abstract.cn: automation 把一个流程变成可以计数、购买、安装、测量的东西。

abstract.en: The figurative sense is a warning: a person can also run on automation, and no one notices until something unusual happens.
abstract.cn: 比喻义是一句警告：人也能靠 automation 运转，直到出现异常，才有人发现。

examples.en: Automation raised output but also raised the skills the remaining workers needed.
examples.cn: 自动化提高了产量，也提高了留下来的工人所需的技能。

examples.en: The warehouse uses automation to sort parcels through the night.
examples.cn: 这个仓库用自动化在夜间分拣包裹。

examples.en: Critics say the new system reduces teaching to automation.
examples.cn: 批评者说这套新制度把教学降成了机械重复。

dict_mnemonic.text: auto（汽车）+ mation（动作）——汽车自己会动，不用人推 → automation 自动化；自动操作

root: 由 automatic + -ion 于 1948 年截合而成（福特副总裁德尔马·S·哈德造词）；automatic 源自希腊语 automatos「自己会动的」（autos「自己」+ matos「思考、有生命」），核心是「无需外力、自己运转」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow the same transfer of control: from hands to a mechanism, from the shop floor to the office, from code to the whole system, and finally from a person to a routine that no longer thinks.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一次控制权移交：从人手到机构，从车间到办公室，从代码到整个系统，最后从一个人移交到不再思考的惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mechanism that keeps working after the hand has let go.
core.cn: 核心意象：手松开之后，机构仍在运转。

branches.en: THE TRANSFER: work handed to machines, and a process that controls itself.
branches.cn: 移交：把工作交给机器，以及自行控制的流程。

branches.en: THE MEANS: automation as a technology, and the installed equipment that embodies it.
branches.cn: 手段：作为技术的自动化，以及承载它的已装设备。

branches.en: THE FACTORY: industrial automation and the measured degree of it.
branches.cn: 工厂：工业自动化及其被测量出的程度。

branches.en: THE DESK AND THE SCRIPT: office automation and a program that runs by itself.
branches.cn: 办公桌与脚本：办公自动化和自行运行的程序。

branches.en: THE MACHINE IN THE PERSON: acting by routine, with no mind behind the action.
branches.cn: 人身上的机器：按惯例行动，行动背后没有心智。

intro.en: automation is auto- (Greek autos, 'self') + mat- (matos, 'acting, thinking') + -ion (process noun). Its family includes automatic, automate, automated, automaton, automatism and automatize; the productive prefix auto- also builds autopilot and autobiography.
intro.cn: automation 是 auto-（希腊语 autos「自己」）+ mat-（matos「行动、思考」）+ -ion（过程名词）。词族包括 automatic、automate、automated、automaton、automatism、automatize；能产前缀 auto- 还造出 autopilot、autobiography。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor: the word is modern. Greek automatos 'self-moving' and automaton 'self-moving thing' supply the stem, and Latin -ionem supplies the noun ending through French.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语祖先：这是现代词。希腊语 automatos「自己会动」与 automaton「自己会动的东西」提供词干，拉丁语 -ionem 经法语提供名词词尾。

items.meaning: the use of self-acting machines to do work
items.example: Automation has changed the shape of the workforce.
items.exampleCN: 自动化改变了劳动力的构成。

items.meaning: self-acting; working by itself
items.example: The door is automatic and opens when you step forward.
items.exampleCN: 这扇门是自动的，你往前走它就开。

definition_zh: 可用性；可获得性；有货；空闲；可用人力；有效性（古义）；可用量；系统可用性；可得性
definition_en: the quality of being usable, obtainable, or free to be called on, whether of a thing, a resource, or a person
core_image: 仓库的门半开，架上还剩最后一箱；有人问的不是它好不好，而是现在能不能拿到
scene: A nurse checks the ward board and says: We have the beds, but staff availability is the real limit.
sceneCN: 这里 availability 指「可用人力、到岗情况」（第 5 个义项：人员能否被调用）；句意：我们有床位，但真正受限的是可到岗的医护人员。画面里有病房白板、排班表和一支马克笔。

pos.zh: 可用性；可获得性；空闲；可用量

collocations.zh: 人员可用情况；到岗情况

senses.title: Fit to be used
senses.titleCN: 可用性：拿起来就能用
senses.definition: the quality of being ready and fit to be used
senses.definitionCN: 处于可被使用的状态或性质
senses.example: The availability of clean water decides where the village is built.
senses.exampleCN: 清洁水源的可用性决定了村庄建在哪里。
senses.why: avail comes from a- 'to' + Latin valere 'be strong, be worth'; -able says 'capable of', and -ity names that capacity. A thing is available when it has the strength to be of use.
senses.whyCN: avail 出自 a-「向」+ 拉丁语 valere「强、有价值」；-able 表示「能够」，-ity 命名这种能力。一样东西可用，就是它有「能被用上」的那股力量。

senses.title: Obtainable when needed
senses.titleCN: 可获得性：需要时能弄到
senses.definition: the state of being obtainable when it is needed
senses.definitionCN: 在需要时能够获得的状态
senses.example: The availability of cheap flights changed the way people travel.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价航班的可获得性改变了人们的出行方式。
senses.why: The modern sense is recorded from 1827 for available, 'at one's disposal'. Availability generalizes it: not merely usable in principle, but findable in the market or in the system.
senses.whyCN: available 的现代义「可支配」记录于 1827 年。availability 把它一般化：不只是原则上能用，而是在市场或系统里找得到。

senses.title: On the shelf
senses.titleCN: 有货：架上还有
senses.definition: the state of being in stock or on sale
senses.definitionCN: 有现货或正在出售的状态
senses.example: Tickets are sold on a first-come basis, subject to availability.
senses.exampleCN: 门票先到先得，视供应情况而定。
senses.why: Commerce narrowed the mass noun to stock on hand. The old sense of 'worth' survives faintly: what is on the shelf is what can be turned to account.
senses.whyCN: 商业把这个不可数名词收窄为「手头现货」。旧义「有价值」还隐约残留：架上的东西才是能派上用场的东西。

senses.title: Free time in a diary
senses.titleCN: 空闲：日程表上的空白
senses.definition: the free time a person has for a meeting or a task
senses.definitionCN: 一个人可用于会议或任务的空间时间
senses.example: The doctor's availability is limited to Tuesday mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 这位医生的空闲时间仅限于周二上午。
senses.why: A person, like a resource, can be 'at disposal'. Scheduling language turns the abstract quality into a block of time that can be booked.
senses.whyCN: 人也可以像资源一样「供支配」。排期语言把这种抽象性质变成一段可以被预订的时间。

senses.title: Hands that can be called on
senses.titleCN: 可用人力：叫得应的人
senses.definition: the extent to which staff are present and able to work
senses.definitionCN: 员工到岗并能工作的程度
senses.example: Staff availability falls sharply during the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 收割期间，可用人力急剧下降。
senses.why: From 'at disposal' the word moves to the labour pool: who can be called on. The measure is human, but the metaphor is still that of a reserve.
senses.whyCN: 从「供支配」出发，这个词转向劳动力储备：谁叫得应。被衡量的是人，但比喻仍是「有一份储备」。

senses.title: Power to help, in older use
senses.titleCN: 有效性：古义里的「管用」
senses.definition: the power to produce a beneficial effect; efficacy, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 产生有益效果的力量；效力（旧义）
senses.example: The pamphlet promised the availability of the new remedy against fever.
senses.exampleCN: 这本小册子宣称这种新药对退烧有效。
senses.why: The 1803 sense was 'capability of advantageous use', closer to avail's original 'be of worth'. The word then meant usefulness, not presence on a shelf.
senses.whyCN: 1803 年的义项是「可供有利使用的性能」，更接近 avail 最初的「有价值」。当时这个词指「有用」，而不是「架上有货」。

senses.title: How much can be drawn
senses.titleCN: 可用量：能抽出来多少
senses.definition: the amount of a resource, especially water, that can be drawn on
senses.definitionCN: 可动用的资源量，尤指水量
senses.example: Climate change is reducing water availability in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 气候变化正在减少该地区的可用水量。
senses.why: Environmental science quantifies the old 'at disposal' idea. Availability becomes a measured volume: what the system can yield without being exhausted.
senses.whyCN: 环境科学把古老的「供支配」观念量化。availability 变成一个有单位体积：系统在不被耗尽的前提下能产出多少。

senses.title: Uptime
senses.titleCN: 系统可用性：一直开着
senses.definition: the proportion of time a system is working and accessible
senses.definitionCN: 系统正常工作并可访问的时间比例
senses.example: The engineers promised 99.9 percent availability for the service.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师承诺这项服务的可用性达到 99.9%。
senses.why: Computing measures the same capacity as a percentage of time. A system is available when it can answer a request, which is valere 'be strong' translated into uptime.
senses.whyCN: 计算领域把同一种能力换算成时间百分比。系统能应答请求就是 available，也就是 valere「强」被翻译成了正常运行时间。

senses.title: What comes to mind
senses.titleCN: 可得性：一想就想得到
senses.definition: the ease with which examples come to mind, used as a mental shortcut in judging frequency
senses.definitionCN: 例子在脑中浮现的容易程度，被用作判断频率的心理捷径
senses.example: The availability heuristic makes rare crashes feel common after one is reported.
senses.exampleCN: 可得性启发让罕见的坠机在报道一起之后显得很常见。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the word for what is mentally 'at hand'. What comes easily to memory is judged frequent; the metaphor of a store one can draw from is unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借这个词指「在脑子里随手可及」的东西。容易想起的就被判断为常见；「有一份储备可抽取」的比喻原封未动。

intro.en: Availability is the abstract noun of available, a word built from avail, 'to be of worth'. Latin valere 'to be strong, be worth' is the muscle in it; -able makes 'capable of being used', and -ity turns that capacity into a measurable quality.
intro.cn: availability 是 available 的抽象名词，而 available 由 avail「有价值、有用」构成。里面的筋骨是拉丁语 valere「强、有价值」；-able 造出「能够被使用」，-ity 再把这种能力变成可测量的性质。

items.en: The root *wal- 'to be strong' is reconstructed from Latin valere and its relatives. There is no written record of this layer, so it is marked source uncertain.
items.cn: 词根 *wal-「强健」是从拉丁语 valere 及其亲属语重构出来的。这一层没有书面记录，因此标为「来源不确定」。

items.en: valere meant 'be strong, be well, be worth'; it also gave validus 'strong' (whence valid), valor and the verb praevalere 'prevail'. Worth and strength were one idea.
items.cn: valere 意为「强健、安好、有价值」；它还给出 validus「强壮的」（即 valid 的来源）、valor，以及动词 praevalere「占优势」。价值与力量在当时是一个概念。

items.en: avail is an Anglo-French compound of a- 'to' + the present stem vaill- of Old French valoir 'be worth', hence 'help, be profitable to, have force'.
items.cn: avail 是英法语的复合词，由 a-「向」+ 古法语 valoir「有价值」的现在时词干 vaill- 构成，意为「帮助、对……有利、有力量」。

items.en: available is recorded as 'beneficial' and 'valid, effective, capable of producing the desired effect', from avail + -able. The date usually cited is the middle of the 15th century.
items.cn: available 被记录为「有益的」和「有效的、能产生预期效果的」，由 avail + -able 构成。通常引用的年代是 15 世纪中叶。

items.en: availability appears as 'capability of advantageous use', from available + -ity. It still meant usefulness rather than presence.
items.cn: availability 以「可供有利使用的性能」出现，由 available + -ity 构成。当时它仍指有用性，而非「在场」。

items.en: available took the sense 'at one's disposal, capable of being made use of' in 1827; availability followed into stock, staff time, water, system uptime and, in the 1970s, the availability heuristic.
items.cn: available 于 1827 年获得「可支配、可利用」义；availability 随之进入库存、人员时间、水量、系统正常运行时间，并在 20 世纪 70 年代进入「可得性启发」。

note.en: The first group shares the avail- stem or the -ability ending; the second group names other kinds of access, supply, or readiness that availability can imply.
note.cn: 第一组共享 avail- 词干或 -ability 词尾；第二组是 availability 可能蕴含的其他「可接近、可供应、已就绪」的说法。

entries.definition: usable, obtainable, or free. It is avail + -able, the base of availability.
entries.definitionCN: 可用的；可获得的；有空的。它是 avail + -able，是 availability 的基础词。

entries.definition: not usable, not obtainable, or not free.
entries.definitionCN: 不可用的；无法获得的；没空的。

entries.definition: the state of not being available. It is the direct opposite of availability.
entries.definitionCN: 不可用；无法获得。它是 availability 的直接反义词。

entries.definition: to be of use or benefit; also benefit itself. The whole family grows from this root.
entries.definitionCN: 有用；有益；益处。整个词族都从这个词根长出来。

entries.definition: the quality of being easy to reach, enter, or use. It stresses the path to the thing.
entries.definitionCN: 可接近性；无障碍性。它强调通向事物之路。

entries.definition: the quality of being reachable as a goal. It stresses effort rather than supply.
entries.definitionCN: 可达性；可实现性。它强调努力，而非供应。

entries.definition: the state of being present in a place or situation. It is the plain fact behind one kind of availability.
entries.definitionCN: 在场；存在。它是某一类 availability 背后的朴素事实。

entries.tag: the stock that can be drawn
entries.definition: the amount of something provided or in stock. It is the quantity side of availability.
entries.definitionCN: 供应量；库存。它是 availability 的数量面。

entries.definition: the state of being prepared and fit for use or action.
entries.definitionCN: 准备就绪；可用状态。

normalIntro.en: avail is 'be of worth'; -able is 'can be'; -ity is 'the quality of'. So availability is literally 'the quality of being able to be of worth'.
normalIntro.cn: avail 是「有价值、有用」；-able 是「能够」；-ity 是「……的性质」。所以 availability 字面就是「能够派上用场的性质」。

normal.en: available + -ity: the adjective of 'can be used' becomes the noun of 'can be used'.
normal.cn: available + -ity：「能用的」形容词，变成「可用性」名词。

normal.en: Same ending as ability: if it is available, it has the ability to be used.
normal.cn: 和 ability 同样的词尾：东西 available，就是有「被使用的能力」。

normal.en: subject to availability means 'if there is any left on the shelf'.
normal.cn: subject to availability 的意思就是「架上还有的话」。

normal.en: A doctor's availability is not a shelf but a blank space in a diary.
normal.cn: 医生的 availability 不是货架，而是日程表上的一块空白。

normal.en: Water availability, system availability, staff availability: one word follows the resource wherever it is.
normal.cn: 可用水量、系统可用性、人员可用情况：资源走到哪，这个词就跟到哪。

abstract.en: Availability always asks a second question: not 'does it exist?' but 'can it be reached now, by this person, for this purpose?'
abstract.cn: availability 总要追问第二层：不是「它存在吗」，而是「现在、这个人、为这个用途，能不能拿到？」

abstract.en: The word carries strength in its root: usable things are the ones with enough force to be turned to account.
abstract.cn: 这个词的词根里带着力量：能用的东西，才有足够的力量被派上用场。

abstract.en: From a shelf to a diary to a memory: the same word measures how close a thing is to the hand.
abstract.cn: 从货架到日程表再到记忆：同一个词测量的都是「东西离手有多近」。

examples.en: The availability of parts delayed the repair by a week.
examples.cn: 零件的可获得性让维修推迟了一周。

examples.en: Please confirm your availability for the meeting on Friday.
examples.cn: 请确认你周五能否出席会议。

examples.en: The study links low water availability to migration.
examples.cn: 这项研究把可用水量低与人口迁移联系起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: a（一个）+ vail（围栏，vale）+ ability（能力）——围栏里还剩一个，有「能拿到」的能力 → availability 可用性；可获得性

root: 源自 avail「有价值、有用」+ -able「能够」+ -ity「性质」；avail 出自 a-（ad-「向」）+ 拉丁语 valere「强、有价值」，核心是「有力量、能被派上用场」，再引申为「可拿到、可支配」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses ask the same practical question in different places: a shelf, a diary, a ward, a reservoir, a server, a memory. In each, availability measures how close the thing is to being used.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项在不同场所问同一个实际问题：货架、日程表、病房、水库、服务器、记忆。每个场景里，availability 都在衡量「这东西离被使用有多近」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching for a thing that is there and free to be taken.
core.cn: 核心意象：手伸向一样就在那里、可以拿走的东西。

branches.en: CAPACITY TO HELP: fit for use, and the older sense of efficacy or worth.
branches.cn: 能帮上忙：适合使用，以及较旧的「有效、有价值」义。

branches.en: OBTAINABLE: findable when needed, and actually in stock.
branches.cn: 能拿到：需要时找得到，以及确实有现货。

branches.en: PEOPLE AT DISPOSAL: free time in a diary and hands that can be called on.
branches.cn: 可供支配的人：日程表上的空档，以及叫得应的人手。

branches.en: MEASURED RESOURCES: a volume of water and a percentage of uptime.
branches.cn: 被测量的资源：可用水量与正常运行时间百分比。

branches.en: AT HAND IN THE MIND: what comes easily to memory and is judged frequent.
branches.cn: 脑中随手可及：容易想起、因而被判断为常见的东西。

intro.en: availability is avail + -able + -ity. avail is a- (ad-, 'to') + val- (Latin valere, 'be strong, be worth'); -able makes 'capable of', -ity makes the quality noun. The negative uses un- twice: unavailable, unavailability.
intro.cn: availability 是 avail + -able + -ity。avail 为 a-（ad-「向」）+ val-（拉丁语 valere「强、有价值」）；-able 造「能够」，-ity 造性质名词。否定式两次用 un-：unavailable、unavailability。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere 'be strong, be worth' yields validus 'strong' (valid), valor, and praevalere 'prevail'; the -abilis suffix behind -able marks capability.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere「强、有价值」给出 validus「强壮的」（即 valid）、valor，以及 praevalere「占优势」；-able 背后的 -abilis 后缀标记「能够」。

items.meaning: the quality of being usable or obtainable
items.example: The availability of the drug varies by region.
items.exampleCN: 这种药的可获得性因地区而异。

items.meaning: to be of use or benefit
items.example: All their efforts availed them nothing.
items.exampleCN: 他们的一切努力都无济于事。

items.meaning: usable, obtainable, or free
items.meaningCN: 可用的；可获得的；有空的
items.example: Tickets are available at the door.
items.exampleCN: 门口有票出售。

items.meaning: not usable, obtainable, or free
items.example: The manager is unavailable until Monday.
items.exampleCN: 经理要到周一才有空。

items.meaning: the state of not being available
items.example: The unavailability of parts stopped production.
items.exampleCN: 零件无法获得，生产因此停顿。

items.meaning: benefit or use obtained
items.example: The old word availment meant a profit gained.
items.exampleCN: 古词 availment 指获得的益处。

items.meaning: sound, legally effective, or logically strong
items.meaningCN: 有效的；正当的；有根据的
items.example: The passport is valid for ten years.
items.exampleCN: 这本护照有效期十年。

items.meaning: the quality of being sound or legally effective
items.example: The court questioned the validity of the contract.
items.exampleCN: 法院质疑这份合同的有效性。

items.meaning: worth, or the importance of something
items.example: The value of the land has doubled.
items.exampleCN: 这块地的价值翻了一番。

items.meaning: to win out or be widespread
items.example: Cooler weather prevailed after the storm.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨后天气转凉。

latinEntries.meaning: to be strong, be well, be worth
